advisoryReview.result: PASS for a non-authorizing dossier; HOLD conversion admission
findings: The first matching capability wins; duplicate capability records do not allow a later available record to override an earlier unavailable record.
Empty preference lists default to cpu.generic, and fallbackRequired:false can return satisfied:true for a plan-only selection.
selectPreferredComputeTarget does not enforce requireOnDevice, allowNetwork or allowSilentFallback at runtime.
createComputeOffloadReport validates, selects and totals while retaining the original plan; verifyWithCpuReference triggers no CPU execution.
createComputeReport retains input arrays, leaves top-level selections empty and does not lift nested target-selection warnings.
NaN and positive Infinity pass the positive/negative checks; collection sizes and nested target searches are caller-supplied and unbounded by runtime code.
There are no hardware probes, kernel calls, scheduling, data transfers or backend execution paths.

translationAssessment.candidateShape: synchronous compute-plan diagnostics, caller-supplied target selection, explicit fallback reporting, offload-stage validation and ordered numeric movement reports over typed records, arrays, strings and numbers
translationAssessment.authorityBoundary: The package describes compute plans and reports only. It does not probe hardware, execute kernels, schedule work, transfer data, verify with a CPU reference or grant runtime authority.
runtimeObligations: Preserve Unicode String.trim, property-read order, strict equality and Array.includes semantics in validation and diagnostics.
Preserve first-match capability selection, preference order, duplicate-record behavior, empty-preference cpu.generic default, fallback flags, satisfied values and warning text.
Preserve that selectPreferredComputeTarget only adds a fallback warning and does not runtime-enforce requireOnDevice, allowNetwork or allowSilentFallback.
Preserve validation-before-selection order, stage order, original plan reference retention and fallbackUsed calculation in createComputeOffloadReport.
Preserve nullish-only optional array defaults, input array aliasing, empty top-level selections and warning extraction order in createComputeReport.
Preserve offload diagnostic order, path construction, negative-byte-only rejection and acceptance of zero, NaN and positive Infinity.
Preserve nested ordered JavaScript numeric reduction, floating-point rounding, overflow, NaN propagation and inclusion of values already diagnosed as negative.
Preserve the non-executable meaning of verifyWithCpuReference and caller-supplied availability metadata.
